headlines.title: Trump claims Iran talks are underway as Tehran denies it
headlines.description: President Donald Trump accused Iran of duplicity and insisted the two sides were discussing reopening the Strait of Hormuz as early as Tuesday, even as Tehran denied talks were even taking place.

headlines.title: Jeanine Pirro Faces Uncertain Future After Reflecting Pool Case
headlines.description: There are mounting questions about whether one of President Donald Trump’s long-time allies, Jeanine Pirro, will keep her job after he lashed out on her decision to drop charges against a former Olympic canoeist indicted for vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Democrats Face Big Test in Critical Michigan Primary
headlines.description: It is primary day in a handful of states and voters are heading to the polls with key races up for grabs that could signal which direction the parties are headed before the November midterms. One of the most closely watched contests is taking place in Michigan, which has become the Democrat’s most expensive Senate primary race ever. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports and Steve Kornacki joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Republican holdouts end opposition to Blanche nomination
headlines.description: Two holdout Republican senators said they will support acting Attorney General Todd Blanche after he scrapped potential payouts to Trump allies. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: GOP senators clear Todd Blanche’s AG path after ‘anti-weaponization’ fund scrapped
headlines.description: Blanche’s nomination had been held up over concerns from GOP Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis, but the parties reached a deal to end the standoff.

headlines.title: Feds charge ‘frustrated’ FBI agent they say stole nearly $1 million in crypto from Russia
headlines.description: The FBI supervisory special agent believed the FBI “could not or would not act against adversarial cryptocurrency accounts,” prosecutors said.

headlines.title: Michigan’s primary reflects a Democratic base transforming in Trump 2.0: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Ethics panel recommends censure for GOP congressman for ‘inappropriate conduct’
headlines.description: The House Ethics Committee said it found “substantial reason” to believe Rep. Chuck Edwards violated House rules on sexual harassment.

headlines.title: Senate leaders reach a deal to avert a shutdown before the 2026 elections
headlines.description: The deal, struck by Republican Susan Collins and Democrat Patty Murray, the leaders on the Senate Appropriations Committee, would keep the government open until Dec. 11.

headlines.title: Trump’s AG pick scraps ‘anti-weaponization’ fund in deal with holdout senators
headlines.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee is set to hold a vote to advance Blanche’s nomination Tuesday.

headlines.title: Former Texas Rep. Kay Granger dies at 83
headlines.description: Republican former Rep. Kay Granger of Texas has died, lawmakers announced Sunday.
